tool_schemas.description: Start a CI run (tests) for a branch or commit. Runs take several minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

tool_schemas.name: get_ci_status
tool_schemas.description: Get the status of a CI run.

tool_schemas.name: wait_for_ci
tool_schemas.description: Wait (up to max_wait_s, default 900) for a CI run to finish and return its result.

tool_schemas.name: list_ci_runs
tool_schemas.description: List CI runs, optionally for a branch or commit.

tool_schemas.name: open_pr

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome, including when the original failed partway (the retry then reports what committed). Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

tool_schemas.name: open_pr_legacy

tool_schemas.name: request_review
tool_schemas.description: Request reviewers on a pull request.

tool_schemas.name: list_prs
tool_schemas.description: List pull requests (state: open, merged, closed or all).

tool_schemas.name: merge_pr
tool_schemas.description: Merge a pull request into its base branch.

args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money, per FIN-212

args.body:
Fixes the nightly build failure by implementing banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in `round_money`, as required by FIN-212 and asserted in `tests/test_money.py`.

- Changed `ROUND_HALF_UP` → `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in src/money.py
- CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986

Reviewer: alex

The PR is now open with alex as reviewer; merging into main awaits code-owner approval per policy, so I have not merged it.
